<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>false</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>wm_order</collection><condition/><description>On work order creation from a case, set location to the case account's location whose city matches the account's city (prefers HQ).</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="wm_order">initiated_fromISNOTEMPTY^locationISEMPTY^EQ<item endquery="false" field="initiated_from" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="ISNOTEMPTY" or="false" value=""/><item endquery="false" field="location" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="ISEMPTY" or="false" value=""/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Set location from case account (city mat</name><order>200</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {
    // Only for work orders initiated from a case
    var cs = new GlideRecord('sn_customerservice_case');
    if (!cs.get(current.getValue('initiated_from')) || cs.account.nil())
        return;

    var acct = new GlideRecord('customer_account');
    if (!acct.get(cs.getValue('account')) || acct.city.nil())
        return;

    // Locations of the account whose city matches the account's city
    var loc = new GlideRecord('cmn_location');
    loc.addQuery('company', acct.getUniqueValue());
    loc.addQuery('city', acct.getValue('city'));
    loc.orderBy('name');
    loc.query();

    var first = '';
    while (loc.next()) {
        if (!first)
            first = loc.getUniqueValue();
        if (/HQ/i.test(loc.getValue('name'))) {
            first = loc.getUniqueValue();
            break;
        }
    }
    if (first)
        current.location = first;
})(current, previous);
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-04 14:37:24</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>b1a740ae9394d750e84732e548373ce3</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Set location from case account (city mat</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_b1a740ae9394d750e84732e548373ce3</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-04 14:37:29</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=b1a740ae9394d750e84732e548373ce3"/></record_update>
